reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs contain no MFN/pricing-parity obligation on Licensee: p0056 and p0078 are fixed user fees and a 33% revenue share, p0089 caps support charges, and p0094 (the only 'other licensees' reference) obliges Licensor to provide Revisions to us, which runs in our favour.

Redline is identical to the original and no comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding under this rule's guidance ('If the Vendor grants Customer best pricing, mark compliant and do not redline').
